temporary_config:
name: studentpath-combined-demo
x-python: &python
  image: studentpath-combined-demo:local
  build:
    context: .
    dockerfile: Dockerfile.check
  init: true
services:
  rabbitmq:
    image: rabbitmq:4-management
    hostname: rabbitmq
    environment:
      RABBITMQ_DEFAULT_USER: demo
      RABBITMQ_DEFAULT_PASS: local-demo-only
    volumes: [broker:/var/lib/rabbitmq]
    healthcheck:
      test: [CMD, rabbitmq-diagnostics, -q, check_port_connectivity]
      interval: 5s
      timeout: 5s
      retries: 20
  seed:
    <<: *python
    command: [python, -m, scripts.demo_pending_update, seed]
    volumes: [collector:/state]
  collector:
    <<: *python
    command: [python, -m, uvicorn, source_collector.snapshot_api:app, --host, 0.0.0.0, --port, '8001']
    environment:
      COLLECTOR_DB: /state/collector.sqlite3
    volumes: [collector:/state]
    depends_on:
      seed: {condition: service_completed_successfully}
  relay:
    <<: *python
    command: [python, -m, source_collector.relay]
    restart: unless-stopped
    environment:
      COLLECTOR_DB: /state/collector.sqlite3
      RABBITMQ_URL: amqp://demo:local-demo-only@rabbitmq:5672/%2F
      RABBITMQ_QUEUE: studentpath.pending.demo
      RELAY_RETRY_SECONDS: '2'
    volumes: [collector:/state]
    depends_on:
      seed: {condition: service_completed_successfully}
      rabbitmq: {condition: service_healthy}
  indexer:
    <<: *python
    command: [python, -m, indexing_worker.consumer]
    restart: unless-stopped
    environment:
      INDEXER_DB: /index/indexer.sqlite3
      COLLECTOR_BASE_URL: http://collector:8001
      RABBITMQ_URL: amqp://demo:local-demo-only@rabbitmq:5672/%2F
      RABBITMQ_QUEUE: studentpath.pending.demo
    volumes: [index:/index]
    depends_on:
      seed: {condition: service_completed_successfully}
      rabbitmq: {condition: service_healthy}
      collector: {condition: service_started}
  retrieval:
    <<: *python
    command: [python, -m, uvicorn, retrieval_api.app:app, --host, 0.0.0.0, --port, '8002']
    environment:
      RETRIEVAL_INDEX_DB: /index/indexer.sqlite3
      COLLECTOR_BASE_URL: http://collector:8001
    volumes: [index:/index:ro]
  answer:
    <<: *python
    command: [python, -m, uvicorn, answer_service.app:app, --host, 0.0.0.0, --port, '8003']
    environment:
      ANSWER_GENERATION_MODE: ollama
      OLLAMA_BASE_URL: http://host.docker.internal:11434
      OLLAMA_MODEL: llama3.2:3b
  gateway:
    <<: *python
    command: [python, -m, uvicorn, gateway.app:app, --host, 0.0.0.0, --port, '8000']
    environment:
      RETRIEVAL_BASE_URL: http://retrieval:8002
      ANSWER_BASE_URL: http://answer:8003
    ports: ['127.0.0.1:8093:8000']
    depends_on: [retrieval, answer]
  web:
    image: nginx:alpine
    ports: ['127.0.0.1:8094:80']
    volumes:
      - ./frontend/dist:/usr/share/nginx/html:ro
      - ./docker-check/combined-nginx.conf:/etc/nginx/conf.d/default.conf:ro
    depends_on: [gateway]
  runner:
    <<: *python
    profiles: [checks]
    environment:
      DEMO_REVISION: ${DEMO_REVISION:-combined-pending-prs}
      DEMO_GENERATION_MODE: ollama
    volumes:
      - collector:/state
      - ./docker-check-results/pending-update:/results
volumes:
  collector:
  index:
  broker:
